data.title: AI and robotics drive an IPO boom in China as Shein lists in Hong Kong
data.description: Chinese markets are booming with new public share listings driven by the craze for artificial intelligence. E-commerce giant Shein's shares are due to debut in Hong Kong on Tuesday in
